title: iRacing Porsche GT3 Suzuka Guide 1:56.1 Porsche 992 R GT3 Suzuka GP Track Guide

corners.braking: Brake at 50 marker, turn in flat
corners.line: Turn in at 50 marker or cone, flat entry
corners.exit: Roll to 40-45%, give room, roll off brakes, back on gas ahead of apex

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: Light dab of brakes, down to third gear
corners.line: Turn in flat, lift as coming across track
corners.exit: Back on gas at apex, don't go 100% before lifting again

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Lightly on the brakes just to get us turned in
corners.line: Turn in, apex at the apex, back on the gas
corners.exit: Back on the gas at the apex

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Get on the brakes, off the gas
corners.line: Get the nose pointed in, back on the gas at the apex
corners.exit: Back on the gas at the apex

corners.label: T7
corners.line: No braking, lift but not full

corners.label: T8
corners.gear: Trail it off down to second
corners.exit: Back on the gas at the apex

corners.label: T9
corners.gear: Trail it off down to second
corners.line: Right-hand tires over rumble strip and curbing
corners.exit: Back on the gas at the apex

corners.label: T11
corners.braking: brake to 50-55% at second to last lamp post, drop to 1st gear
brake to 45-50% before entrance road, trail off
corners.line: pick back up on gas at apex

corners.label: T15
corners.line: turn-in at 50, apex at curb, exit on right side
corners.exit: back on gas at apex, keep left tires on track
corners.mistakes: too early turn-in leads to off-track

general_tips: Use light brake dabs to ensure weight over front wheels for turn-in grip
blip of gas, lift over second curb
